scope: all 360 saved scenario-run records in four files; every failed record is included

method.expected_decision: derived from applicable saved clarification/refusal metric, using the existing routing metric convention
method.primary_categories: exclusive priority: invalid, unknown, wrong decision, correct-decision wording-score mismatch, arguments, tools, execution, other
method.diagnostic_flags: non-exclusive; cannot be added together as a failure total
method.wording_score_mismatch: saved correct decision plus keyword metric below 1; not a semantic verdict that the wording is wrong
method.raw_output_inspection: existing strict parser; intact JSON prefixes inspected only to label rejected output, never to accept or score it
method.old_helper_not_used: classify_boundary_generation only checks the first name and can mistake malformed meta-tools for correct_decision_wrong_wording
method.productive_name_validation: AgentToolCall rejects the undotted productive name paste_into_path; diagnostic only, no parser change
